summary: Acquired by **Fiserv** (terms undisclosed), announced Sep 4, 2025; being integrated into Clover for hospitality — see Fiserv (Clover) in round one

Mobile ordering, payments and loyalty built by the team behind the original Starbucks and Dunkin' apps. It brings Clover drive-thru software, kiosk support and third-party loyalty/delivery integrations
Gives Clover a drive-thru and multi-location enterprise play, a new threat to Genius drive-thru and mid-market chains
Jon Squire — CardFree founder & CEO (at acquisition)
Deal sponsored by Takis Georgakopoulos (then Fiserv COO, now CEO)

CardFree currently describes mobile order, payment and loyalty tools for restaurants and convenience stores. (Scope note: Undated vendor page does not establish current chain deployment or financial health.)
